iti54:1.1: I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti54:2.1: Tisso imā bhikkhave esanā. Katamā tisso? Kāmesanā bhavesanā brahmacariyesanā, imā kho bhikkhave tisso esanā ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti54:3.1: Samāhito sampajāno sato buddhassa sāvako | esanā ca pajānāti esanānañca sambhavaṃ ||
iti54:4.1: yattha cetā nirujjhanti maggañca khayagāminaṃ | esanānaṃ khayā bhikkhu nicchāto parinibbuto ti ||
iti54:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||5||
